app/server/api/abilities/[name].get.ts — handler delete removes the whole feature's server side

app/app/components/SiteHeader.vue:9-12 — nav has no Abilities link, so nothing to scrub
removability.rationale: Delete two route directories and one page section; no scattered references, no orphaned helpers.

evidence: app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:15-17 — spriteUrl is the single sprite source; a fix covers every card list (app/server/api/pokedex.get.ts:47, pokeapi.ts:125)
app/app/utils/format.ts:6 vs app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:43 — humanize implemented twice; a name-formatting fix lands twice
app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:60 vs app/server/api/types/[name].get.ts:9 — excluded-types list duplicated
app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:123 vs app/server/api/pokedex.get.ts:20 — alternate-forms rule duplicated
changeability.rationale: The risky cross-cutting fixes (sprites, API base, caching) each have one obvious home, but three small rules are duplicated between client and server utils.

evidence: app/app/composables/usePageData.ts:5-12 — pages talk to the server only through /api DTOs and one error convention
app/app/components/PokemonCard.vue:3-7 — narrow prop shape ({id,name,sprite}+optional types/note); lists only pass data through
app/app/pages/pokemon/[name].vue:59 — page consumes server's positional learn tuple, an implicit cross-boundary contract
app/app/pages/moves/[name].vue:3-13 — DTO interface re-declared locally, duplicating the server handler's output shape
coupling.rationale: Clear server/client seam and narrow component props; coupling is via undeclared shared DTO shapes and one positional tuple rather than internals.

evidence: app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:114-135 — cardsFor + extra() callback stretches cleanly to abilities' hidden flag
app/app/components/PageSection.vue:4-10, TypeBadge.vue:4-8, CardGrid.vue:1-3 — small, single-purpose, reusable pieces
app/app/components/MoveTable.vue:29 — showLevel boolean is the only flag creep, justified by real variation
app/app/components/CardGrid.vue:1-3 — bare slot <ul>; card-list behavior (sort, count, empty state) is re-written per page rather than abstracted
abstraction_design.rationale: Abstractions track the app's real variation well; the missing piece is a card-list wrapper, so list-level behaviour gets copied into each page.

findings.issue: humanize is implemented independently on client and server; a display-rule change (e.g. Mr. Mime) must be made twice.
findings.suggestion: Move it to shared/utils/ (auto-imported in both app and server contexts in Nuxt 4) and delete both copies.

findings.issue: Moves are shipped as positional tuples [versionGroup, method, level]; extending the learn model or reading it is opaque.
findings.suggestion: Return named objects ({ versionGroup, method, level }) and type them once (e.g. a shared MoveLearn interface).

findings.issue: The excluded-types list (stellar/unknown/shadow) is hardcoded in two places.
findings.suggestion: Export a single isPlayableType()/EXCLUDED_TYPES from server/utils/pokeapi.ts and reuse it in the type handler.

findings.issue: The home payload rebuilds card-shaped data (alternate-form filter, sprite, sort by id) parallel to cardsFor instead of reusing it.
findings.suggestion: Extract the id>10000 filter and sprite assembly into the shared helper (or shared constants) so card rules live in one place.

findings.issue: Each page re-declares the server DTO as a local interface; contract changes require finding and editing both sides with no compile-time link.
findings.suggestion: Declare the DTOs once in a shared types module imported by both the Nitro handler and the page.

findings.issue: CardGrid is a bare slot <ul>; count text, sorting and empty states are duplicated across four pages, so a list-level change is per-page.
findings.suggestion: Optionally lift 'count + list' rendering into a CardList component with a slot, or accept the duplication given the lists are small.

summary: A clean, current-idiom Nuxt 4 codebase with a genuine server/client seam: Nitro handlers own all PokeAPI fan-out and shaping, pages consume DTOs through one composable, and components are small with narrow props. Removal, sprite fixes and data-source changes all land in one or two obvious places; the main editability costs are a duplicated humanize (fixable with shared/utils), a positional learn tuple, and per-page duplication of card-list behaviour.
